name: kamod-tracking
description: First-party product analytics for Kamod apps: consent-aware, origin-explicit, no fingerprinting.
author: Klaus Zahiragic <watzak>

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "console.error('Do not publish the workspace root. Use: pnpm publish:core'); process.exit(1)"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm test && pnpm test:examples && pnpm build && pnpm check:exports && pnpm measure:bundle && pnpm e2e:smoke
scripts.test:examples: pnpm build:core && node --experimental-strip-types examples/devjobs/registry.test.mjs && node examples/vanilla-browser/demo.mjs && pnpm --filter @kamod-tracking/example-server-outbox-postgres test && node examples/preact-consent-visibility/smoke-export.mjs
scripts.publish:core: node -e "console.error('Publishing is out of scope for this workspace.'); process.exit(1)"
